resolution: The latest live spike paste showed a misleading report shape: the host tape still contained an old bad frame while the sampled counters/text trace were already from a recovered frame, so stale deltas like glyph_count 972->929 and text_hash flips were being printed as if they happened on the worst frame. I fixed the spike reporter to gate verdicts, owner traces, and text-trace evidence on whether the latest frame actually caught the spike, refresh calm snapshots on recovered ticks, and label recovered-frame diffs explicitly. I also fixed the host text trace to include the actual glyph atlas render-size bucket () in addition to requested fontSize, so the next caught glyph-raster spike can name the text whose fractional/effective size is changing instead of saying the text trace is unchanged. Built hmsc-int through tools/rjit and tools/rjit game verify is green; not claiming live PASS until the user's post-push session either stops host-spike lines or the new render-size trace names the remaining offender.
